description: This file declares utility functions and macros for JSON handling, including memory debugging and compatibility features, used within a larger C project.

methods.name: json_split
methods.description: Splits a JSON string into parts or tokens.

methods.name: json_dumps_static
methods.description: Serializes a JSON object into a static string with specified flags.

methods.name: json_gets
methods.description: Extracts a string value from a JSON object with size limit and flags.

methods.name: json_get_str
methods.description: Retrieves a string from a JSON object with size limit.

methods.name: json_memdbg_init
methods.description: Initializes JSON memory debugging with an event loop.

methods.name: json_memdbg_free
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for JSON debugging.

methods.name: json_memdbg_get_stats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics on total memory and count for JSON debugging.

methods.name: json_memdbg_report
methods.description: Reports JSON memory debugging information, optionally only differences.

methods.name: json_free
methods.description: Frees memory allocated by json_dumps() using the appropriate allocator.
